_note: I053 (docs/code/menus-inventory-status-hud.md): note corrections found while writing the document. (1) ExitEquipmentMenu is only the SEC/RTS return of RunEquipmentMenu; the restore of video state, graphics, palettes and pose is the tail of OpenEquipmentMenu, so two part notes named the wrong routine as the caller. (2) LoadEquippedMagicGfx runs after every menu close and scene load, not only when the magic changes: the menu's character data (VRAM $2000-$2FFF) overwrites the spell graphics at word $2600. (3) MagicPalettePointers has 3-byte entries like MagicGraphicsPointers (the code indexes both with 3 x n and reads only the word). (4) player_exp_next is the next level's EXP total (the LevelExpThresholds value that WatchForLevelUp compares with player_exp), not the EXP still needed. (5) A doubled library name in the lib_menus block note.
